notes.title: 📢 Update v1.2.0 (July 19th, 2025)
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Here comes a new update with mechanic improvements and a few balance tweaks based on your suggestions.



In-Game Updates

Cleaning System:

The "Next Step" mechanic has been changed to a Press & Hold system.

Previously, progress would trigger instantly on button press, now it requires holding the button, helping prevent unwanted or accidental progress steps.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148126/cb149540e9ec69892ec6d5513887be03decb70f8.png"]



Tool Detail UI:

Upgrade button now includes clearer info and better visual feedback.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148126/3d72f0a1673e640a22b571564ae3c5eb638e084a.gif"]

Economy:

Sponge upgrade costs have been reduced drastically

UI & Quality of Life:

UX improvements in the upgrade interface


As always, thanks for all your feedback, it really helps shape the game!

More updates coming soon 💙🧽🚗💦

notes.title: Express Car Wash Simulator: Prologue Released! 🚘✨
notes.content:
A little bit of a late post, but I wanted to officially announce that the game is now live! First of all, thank you so much for all your support, it truly means a lot to me.

Since launch day, the feedback has been overwhelmingly positive, which made me really happy. Thanks to your valuable feedback, we’ve already fixed a few bugs and improved some parts of the game experience together.

To talk a little about myself and this journey; I’m developing this game solo as an indie developer. Like any job, of course there’s a financial side to it, but what matters most to me is seeing people enjoy what I’ve created and having fun. I built this project with that same passion. And since this is my first ever PC game, it holds a very special place for me.

So what’s next?

I’m planning to launch an Early Access version soon. To focus more on that, I’ll be wrapping up support for the Prologue version probably after one content update which will probably includes adding of the language system. Of course, if any technical issues come up, I’ll still be around to help.

I’d love to hear any of your feedback, questions, and suggestions. Thanks again for your amazing support and happy foaming! 🧽🚗💦
